query:
SELECT ce.id
                    FROM collection_entry ce
                    WHERE EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM trade_card tc
                        WHERE tc.trade_id = $1
                          AND tc.owner_user_id = ce.user_id
                          AND tc.set_code = ce.set_code
                          AND tc.collector_number = ce.collector_number
                          AND tc.language_code = ce.language_code
                    )
                    ORDER BY ce.id
                    FOR SHARE
